title: Ask HN: What are you reading?
summary: A Hacker News user shares their current reading list including Dungeon Crawler Carl (LitRPG series) and Cory Doctorow's Enshittification, seeking intellectually challenging book recommendations from the HN community. The post generated significant engagement with 695 comments discussing various book recommendations across genres.
problem_solved: Connects readers with thoughtful book recommendations from a community of diverse readers
why_valuable: High engagement (359 points, 695 comments) demonstrates the HN community's enthusiasm for discussing literature and sharing reading recommendations across genres
